summary.name: Mailspring
summary.one_liner: Mailspring is a free, open source desktop email client for Mac, Windows and Linux with multi-account support, a unified inbox, and optional Pro features such as read receipts and link tracking.
use_cases: managing multiple email accounts in one inbox
writing emails with grammar and spell checking
using a desktop email client with IMAP and Office 365
summary.what_it_does: Mailspring is a native desktop email app for Mac, Windows and Linux. It supports multiple accounts (IMAP, Office 365, and providers such as Gmail, iCloud, Outlook.com, Yahoo and FastMail) in a unified inbox, with Gmail-style search that indexes message contents across accounts. The composer offers spell checking and grammar checking powered by LanguageTool, plus signature editing and undo send. Pro adds read receipts, link tracking, send later, follow-up reminders, templates and an activity tab. The page says mail syncs directly via IMAP, CalDAV and CardDAV rather than through Mailspring's servers.
notable: Open source under the MIT license with a native C++ sync engine
Free core client; Pro features at $8/month with a few free test-drives per week
Grammar and spell checking in the composer via LanguageTool
Native integration with taskbars, notifications, system tray and Do Not Disturb
caveats: Read receipts, link tracking, send later (unlimited), follow-up reminders and templates require Mailspring Pro at $8/month
The full calendar with Day View and Agenda View is described as coming later this year, so calendar support is limited for now
